title: Client brief
description: EPYHIA's input contract. The ONLY channel through which client-specific facts enter the system (DESIGN.md 5.1, FR-001). Persisted verbatim as briefs.payload with a content_sha256. This schema is fixed; its contents vary entirely by client. Nothing in this file may name or presuppose any particular client.

products.description: The catalogue. Ops creates Stripe products and prices from this at run time; no product, price, currency or billing type may exist anywhere in EPYHIA's own code, config or fixtures (FR-027).

price_minor.description: Amount in minor units, so the grounding check and Stripe product creation read one number from one place (DESIGN.md 5.1).

currency_display.description: May differ from currency_charge. No conversion is ever performed (research.md R6).

currency_charge.description: ISO 4217. What Stripe actually charges in.

billing.description: Per product, never a global setting (FR-003).

billing_interval.description: How often a recurring charge repeats. Required when billing is subscription and meaningless otherwise: a recurring price cannot be created without a cadence, and a cadence chosen in EPYHIA's code would be a billing interval hardcoded for every client at once (FR-003, FR-027).

billing_interval_count.description: Intervals between charges. Omitted means every interval — the field is left off the processor call entirely rather than defaulted here.

established.description: Year. The literal, and the source of the (current_year - established) derivation.
